2026 Leaf Metal Happy Holidays

Leaf Trading Cards is proud to announce the return of the most festive product of the season with 2026 Leaf Metal Happy Holidays! This product is sure to bring joy to collectors of all ages. Get into the spirit of the season with fun holiday-themed die-cut cards. These festive designs bring a unique seasonal look for 2026. Look for six different holiday backgrounds in the Winter Wonderland Signature set. This year’s lineup features an all-new claymation background. Look for another holiday tradition with The 12 Days of Christmas themed autographs. Collect all 12 days for each featured subject. No holiday party is complete without an ugly sweater! Look for rare Ugly Sweater Signatures, exclusive to Ugly Sweater Edition boxes and cases.
